description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class `EmpEmergencyContactSearchFilterParams` used for filtering search parameters related to employee emergency contacts within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base filter parameters class and includes properties for employee number and contact name, along with associated getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactSearchFilterParams
classes.description: DTO class for specifying search filters for employee emergency contacts, including employee number and contact name, with sorting capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters by setting the default sort field to 'eec.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the filter.
